stories.title: Delays building on the A550 after collision near Two Mills traffic lights
stories.summary: The A550 Welsh Road is closed in both directions following a road traffic collision between the Two Mills traffic lights and Woodbank Lane. Traffic reports show the closure became active at 3.55pm on Friday 14 August, with slow traffic building on the approach. The closed stretch runs between the junction with the A540 Parkgate Road

stories.title: Disposable barbecues temporarily banned from sale in Flintshire shops
stories.summary: Shops in Flintshire that keep selling disposable barbecues during the drought will be in breach of product safety law, and can be prosecuted. stories.title: Home Office pauses Gronant asylum housing plan after MP meeting
stories.summary: The Home Office says it is listening to local concerns to reduce the impact of asylum housing on communities like Gronant following strong local opposition. Residents of the Flintshire village have been caught in a whirlwind in the week since plans to move migrants awaiting asylum decisions into the 13 properties at the redeveloped  Gronant

stories.title: North Wales firefighters deployed to help tackle wildfires across Wales
stories.summary: Firefighters and resources from North Wales have been deployed to help tackle major wildfires burning across other parts of Wales. North Wales Fire and Rescue Service has sent staff and resources to assist crews from Mid and West Wales Fire and Rescue Service, while equipment has also been provided to South Wales Fire and Rescue
